title: Conditional-entropy security of asymmetric AONTs under arbitrary priors
summary: Characterize the information-theoretic security of every combinatorial asymmetric AONT or weak-AONT under an arbitrary prior input distribution.

formal_statement.body: For every combinatorial asymmetric $(t_i,t_o,s,v)$-AONT or weak-AONT $A$, every prior distribution on its input $s$-tuples, every set $X$ of $t_i$ input coordinates, and every set $Y$ of $s-t_o$ output coordinates, characterize $H(X\mid Y)$ exactly, including necessary and sufficient conditions for perfect and weak security.

scope.domain: Combinatorial asymmetric all-or-nothing transforms under arbitrary prior input distributions
assumptions: $A$ is a combinatorial asymmetric $(t_i,t_o,s,v)$-AONT or weak-AONT in the source sense
Security is measured by the source's conditional entropy $H(X\mid Y)$
scope.unresolved_remainder: The source extends its independent-input bounds and selected exact cases to asymmetric AONTs and recalls known equiprobable or positive-support guarantees. It does not characterize arbitrary dependent prior distributions for all asymmetric AONTs and weak-AONTs.

citations.label: Gu--Akao--Esfahani--Miao--Sakurai, asymmetric AONT security problem
citations.locator: Problem 8, journal p. 6906; Conclusion, journal p. 6913

progress.summary: Problem 8 asks for the security properties of asymmetric combinatorial AONTs and weak-AONTs for general prior input distributions.
